git.note: rev is the authoring tree HEAD. The benchmark itself ran on the box from a fresh `git clone --depth 1` of origin/main at run time; the exact box commit was not captured.

model.name: glm_moe_dsa (synthetic)
model.note: cmd/glmdsatput builds synthetic GLM-5.2-shaped weights (8 layers, dense FFN, no MoE routing) and benchmarks the native CUDA decode/prefill path. This is a kernel-wiring + shape-scaling witness, NOT a measurement of the real 753B GLM-5.2 checkpoint. Treat every tok/s as an optimistic lower bound for the wiring, not a model result.

method: One A100 (40 GB) card of an 8-GPU datacenter server. cmd/glmdsatput was built once (sm_80 libfakcuda.a) and invoked per context length, varying only -decode-prompt. Each point reports the median over 5 reps for decode (64 steps) and prefill. The axis under test is context length (prompt tokens fed before decode); everything else is held fixed. Measures how the DSA (MLA + sparse top-k index) decode and prefill paths scale with prompt length.

box.gpu: 1x NVIDIA A100 (40 GB, sm_80), one card of an 8-GPU datacenter server
box.note: A peer job held ~35 GB resident-but-idle (0% util) on every card at run time, leaving ~5 GB free per card. The single-GPU synthetic microbench (~2-3 GB) runs cleanly on top; this is also why the 32-layer size configs OOM on this node.

findings: DSA decode is NOT context-flat: per-token decode rose 37.583 -> 47.839 ms/tok (+27.3%) as decode-prompt went 128 -> 512 (4x), even with index-topk=256 sparse selection. Measured fact is the +27.3% rise; a plausible (not proven by this 2-point run) mechanism is that the top-k indexer still scans the full KV each decode step, so decode cost grows with context even though sparsity caps the attention math.
Prefill degrades super-linearly: prefill wall rose 3568 -> 20692 ms (5.8x) for a 4x longer prompt; prefill throughput fell 35.87 -> 24.74 tok/s, consistent with O(n^2) attention over the prompt.

decode-prompt 2048 (and beyond) was not collected: O(n^2) prefill x 5 reps makes each long-context point ~15-40 min under this un-optimized synthetic kernel, so the sweep was capped at 512 to free the shared GPU.
